article.story: NEW YORK -- — Josh Baldwin's 19 points helped Cornell defeat Columbia 88-67 on Saturday. Baldwin had 10 rebounds for the Big Red (11-10, 4-4 Ivy League). Adam Hinton scored 13 points while shooting 6 for 10, including 1 for 3 from beyond the arc and added five rebounds. Cooper Noardfinished with 12 points. The Lions (14-8, 3-5) were led by Kenny Noland, who posted 21 points. Columbia also got 13 points from Connor Igoe. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
